Product Manager with 8.5+ years of experience building and scaling B2B and B2C SaaS products across construction, healthcare, telecom, banking, and eCommerce.
Proven in defining product vision, executing roadmaps, and delivering measurable outcomes such as 50–75% efficiency gains, 60%+ user retention, and double-digit adoption growth.

responsibilities: Owned product roadmap and execution for a GenAI-enabled SaaS platform used by engineers.
Defined MVP scope, success metrics, and phased roadmap aligned with business outcomes and adoption goals.
Led stakeholder and client requirement analysis to validate problem statements, drive feature prioritization, and ensure alignment with business goals.

Defined and prioritized the AI product roadmap covering Agentic AI, RAG, LLM and intelligent automation capabilities, translating customer/business requirements into scalable AI features and measurable product outcomes
Created and maintained documentation including FRD, BRD, SRS, epics, and user stories to ensure clear communication across teams.
Established KPI tracking and ROI analysis to guide investment decisions and executive reporting.
Responsible for developing a new product strategy for expanding the client portfolio presence in the marketplace especially focusing on 3rd party life cycle tool integration.
Led the development and launch of a B2B SaaS platform, resulting in a 60% user retention.
Acted as primary decision-maker for backlog prioritization using weighted scoring models tied to retention and revenue impact
Hands-on experience with OpenAI-powered GenAI solutions, leveraging OpenAI LLMs for prompt engineering, RAG-based knowledge retrieval, and development of context-aware enterprise AI capabilities.
Collaborated with engineers, design & sales teams to define product requirements & timelines.
Conducted user interviews and surveys, synthesizing insights to prioritize the features using a weighted scoring model.
Boosted feature adoption by 22% via A/B testing and iterative optimization.
Built product roadmaps and presented updates to C-level stakeholders.
Wrote user stories and managed backlogs in Jira for bi-weekly sprint planning.
Created wireframes & collaborated with UX teams to enhance onboarding, reducing drop-off by 15%.
Assisted in developing KPIs & created dashboards in Tableau for product performance tracking.
Partnered with stakeholders to ensure regulatory compliance across healthcare and telecom domains, reducing operational and reputational risks.
Assisted in preparing budget forecasts and resource utilization plans, optimizing project costs without compromising delivery timelines.
Developed and presented financial and performance reports to senior leadership, providing transparency on product health and profitability.
Managed the design and delivery of a cloud-based order management platform, reducing provisioning time by 75%.
Defined the product roadmap and MVP in alignment with business goals and customer pain points.
Defined end-to-end service journeys across broadband, mobile, and VoIP, improving order success rate by 35%
Partnered with UI/UX teams to improve user journeys, enhancing order success and customer satisfaction.
Oversaw seamless integration with OSS/BSS systems to enable automation and accurate data flow.
Created and maintained user stories, epics, and documentation in JIRA and Confluence.
Led UAT efforts, coordinated release plans, and supported internal training and change management.
Tracked KPIs post-launch, achieving a 35% increase in successful order completions and reduced inquiries.

residual_blocks.quote: Core Competencies:
Product Management & Strategy: Product vision and roadmapping, MVP definition, market and user
research, Generative AI Product Ownership, Requirement Gathering, A/B testing, Sprint Planning, and
Go-to-market (GTM) execution. Experienced in Epics, Features, User Stories, PRDs, BRDs, and FRDs.
Owned and delivered Agentic AI product capabilities using autonomous AI workflows to automate
document analysis, reasoning, and user interactions across enterprise SaaS use cases.
Agile & Delivery: Hands-on experience with Scrum and Kanban, backlog prioritization, sprint
ceremonies, cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder management, and end-to-end Agile delivery.
Designed and implemented RAG-based solutions using OpenAI/LLM technologies, integrating
enterprise documents and knowledge sources to generate context-aware responses and improve

Project Name: Akordi
Client: Laing O’Rourke | Role: Product Manager| Team Size: 30| Duration: July 2024 – Present
Environment: JIRA, Confluence, Pivotal Tracker, Python, SQL, APIs, Gitlab.
Description: Akordi is a web-based progressive application developed for engineers in the construction
industry to streamline their daily activities. It centralizes data from ongoing Laing O’Rourke projects and
assigns user-specific workspaces, enabling engineers to access and contribute project-related information
collaboratively within their teams. Designed with a user-focused approach, the platform integrates
generative AI to interpret uploaded documents and provide intelligent responses, supporting enhanced
productivity and paving the way for future growth through AI-driven innovations.
Responsibilities:
Drove a 50% improvement in client retention by prioritizing high-impact workflows and AI-
assisted document intelligence.
Partnered with cross-functional and distributed teams (engineering, design, sales) to deliver bi-
weekly releases through Agile ceremonies.
Product Owner / Business Analyst - (March 2022 – June 2024)
Client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner / Business Analyst | Team Size: 12 | Duration: March 2022 –
June 2024 | Environment: JIRA, Confluence, Pivotal Tracker, Python, SQL, APIs, Gitlab.
Description: Built a web-based surgical video analytics platform used by surgeons to review procedures
and enhance training. Led roadmap planning, A/B testing, and cross-functional collaboration. Achieved
60% user retention and reduced onboarding drop-off by 15%.
Responsibilities:
Client: ConnectSphere, Horizon Networks | Role: Product Manager / Product Owner | Team Size: 20 |
Duration: June 2022 – March 2023| Environment: JIRA, Confluence, Figma, APIs, Swagger, SQL
Description: OmniLink is a next-gen telecom order management and service provisioning platform built
for major telecom providers, ConnectSphere and Horizon Networks. It streamlined customer onboarding
across broadband, mobile, and VoIP services by unifying service journeys and automating backend
provisioning. The platform integrated with legacy OSS/BSS systems, enabling real-time tracking,
reducing manual interventions, and significantly improving service activation timelines and customer
experience.
Responsibilities:
Developed and presented financial and performance reports to senior leadership, providing
transparency on product health and profitability.
Assisted in preparing budget forecasts and resource utilization plans, optimizing project costs
without compromising delivery timelines.
Client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner | Team Size: 8 | Duration: Apr 2021 – Feb 2022 |
Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: SP Portal is a progressive web application developed for Whirlpool's internal operations,
supporting multiple user roles including District Managers, Service Providers, and Administrators who
oversee overall application management. Its primary purpose is to streamline the claims process by
enabling users to filter and manage claims based on status, time, and other criteria. The application
features a dedicated section for viewing individual claim details & another for consolidating multiple
claims using claim numbers. It facilitates smooth claim processing by allowing District Managers to initiate
actions which are then carried forward by Service Providers, ensuring efficient and organized workflow.
Responsibilities
Client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner / Test Engineer | Team Size: 6 | Duration: Oct 2021 – Apr 2022
| Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git
Description: Whirlpool Sales Strategy and Operations is a progressive web application developed for
internal use within Whirlpool. It supports three distinct user roles—Admin, Editor, and General User—
each with role-specific access and permissions. The application serves as a centralized platform to display
ongoing organizational projects, offering complete project details, trending updates, quick links, and
progress reports. It also includes features such as user location tracking to enhance visibility. Designed to
be user-friendly, the application ensures a seamless experience across mobile, desktop, and tablet
devices, with the goal of improving accessibility and engagement for all users.
Responsibilities
Client: Cadent- Gas Network | Role: Product Owner / Test Engineer | Team Size: 7 | Duration: Jan 2021
Jan 2022 | Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: Cadent is a progressive web application designed to manage new and existing gas
connections across European regions, ensuring seamless customer service delivery. The platform allows
users to submit connection, site, contact, and payment details through an intuitive web form. Based on
location and site plans, the system generates detailed quotations and assigns application numbers for
processing through an admin portal. This application streamlines customer requests, optimizes
connection workflows, and enhances service delivery.
Responsibilities

targets.text: Persistent Systems (Bengaluru)
Product Owner / Business Analyst - (March 2022 – June 2024)
Project Name: Caresyntax
Client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner / Business Analyst | Team Size: 12 | Duration: March 2022 –
June 2024 | Environment: JIRA, Confluence, Pivotal Tracker, Python, SQL, APIs, Gitlab.
Description: Built a web-based surgical video analytics platform used by surgeons to review procedures
and enhance training. Led roadmap planning, A/B testing, and cross-functional collaboration. Achieved
60% user retention and reduced onboarding drop-off by 15%.
Responsibilities:
Responsible for developing a new product strategy for expanding the client portfolio presence in
the marketplace especially focusing on 3rd party life cycle tool integration.
Led the development and launch of a B2B SaaS platform, resulting in a 60% user retention.
Acted as primary decision-maker for backlog prioritization using weighted scoring models tied to
retention and revenue impact
Hands-on experience with OpenAI-powered GenAI solutions, leveraging OpenAI LLMs for
prompt engineering, RAG-based knowledge retrieval, and development of context-aware
enterprise AI capabilities.
Collaborated with engineers, design & sales teams to define product requirements & timelines.
Conducted user interviews and surveys, synthesizing insights to prioritize the features using a
weighted scoring model.
Boosted feature adoption by 22% via A/B testing and iterative optimization.
Built product roadmaps and presented updates to C-level stakeholders.
Wrote user stories and managed backlogs in Jira for bi-weekly sprint planning.
Created wireframes & collaborated with UX teams to enhance onboarding, reducing drop-off by
Assisted in developing KPIs & created dashboards in Tableau for product performance tracking.
Partnered with stakeholders to ensure regulatory compliance across healthcare and telecom
domains, reducing operational and reputational risks.
Assisted in preparing budget forecasts and resource utilization plans, optimizing project costs
without compromising delivery timelines.
Developed and presented financial and performance reports to senior leadership, providing
transparency on product health and profitability.
Project Name: OmniLink
Client: ConnectSphere, Horizon Networks | Role: Product Manager / Product Owner | Team Size: 20 |
Duration: June 2022 – March 2023| Environment: JIRA, Confluence, Figma, APIs, Swagger, SQL
Description: OmniLink is a next-gen telecom order management and service provisioning platform built
for major telecom providers, ConnectSphere and Horizon Networks. It streamlined customer onboarding
across broadband, mobile, and VoIP services by unifying service journeys and automating backend
provisioning. The platform integrated with legacy OSS/BSS systems, enabling real-time tracking,
reducing manual interventions, and significantly improving service activation timelines and customer
Responsibilities:
Managed the design and delivery of a cloud-based order management platform, reducing
provisioning time by 75%.
Defined the product roadmap and MVP in alignment with business goals and customer pain
points.
Defined end-to-end service journeys across broadband, mobile, and VoIP, improving order
success rate by 35%
Partnered with UI/UX teams to improve user journeys, enhancing order success and customer
satisfaction.
Oversaw seamless integration with OSS/BSS systems to enable automation and accurate data
flow.
Created and maintained user stories, epics, and documentation in JIRA and Confluence.
Led UAT efforts, coordinated release plans, and supported internal training and change
management.
Developed and presented financial and performance reports to senior leadership, providing
transparency on product health and profitability.
Assisted in preparing budget forecasts and resource utilization plans, optimizing project costs
without compromising delivery timelines.
Tracked KPIs post-launch, achieving a 35% increase in successful order completions and reduced
inquiries.
Mediaagility Pvt. Ltd (Acquired by Persistent Systems)
Product Owner - (Jan 2021 – March 2022)
Project Name: SP Portal
Client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner | Team Size: 8 | Duration: Apr 2021 – Feb 2022 |
Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: SP Portal is a progressive web application developed for Whirlpool's internal operations,
supporting multiple user roles including District Managers, Service Providers, and Administrators who
oversee overall application management. Its primary purpose is to streamline the claims process by
enabling users to filter and manage claims based on status, time, and other criteria. The application
features a dedicated section for viewing individual claim details & another for consolidating multiple
claims using claim numbers. It facilitates smooth claim processing by allowing District Managers to initiate
actions which are then carried forward by Service Providers, ensuring efficient and organized workflow.
Responsibilities
Gathered and analyzed business requirements, system specifications, and translated them into
BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Defined project scope, timelines, and strategies; facilitated stakeholder meetings and
workshops for requirement clarification.
Acted as a liaison between business, QA, and development teams, ensuring defect resolution,
quality delivery, and smooth release cycles.
Planned and executed UAT, analyzed gaps, and recommended process improvements for better
business outcomes.
Utilized tools like JIRA, Confluence, and Katalon Studio for documentation, traceability, and
process optimization.
Project Name: Whirlpool Sales Strategy and Operations
Client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner / Test Engineer | Team Size: 6 | Duration: Oct 2021 – Apr 2022
| Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git
Description: Whirlpool Sales Strategy and Operations is a progressive web application developed for
internal use within Whirlpool. It supports three distinct user roles—Admin, Editor, and General User—
each with role-specific access and permissions. The application serves as a centralized platform to display
ongoing organizational projects, offering complete project details, trending updates, quick links, and
progress reports. It also includes features such as user location tracking to enhance visibility. Designed to
be user-friendly, the application ensures a seamless experience across mobile, desktop, and tablet
devices, with the goal of improving accessibility and engagement for all users.
Responsibilities
Analysed system specifications and translated requirements into detailed documentation,
scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
Coordinated with developers, QA, and clients to track defects, ensure quality, and deliver
seamless product releases.
Led multi-device, cross-platform verification, UAT planning, and execution to validate business
needs.
Supported automation initiatives and database validations, recommending improvements for
better system performance.
Project Name: Cadent
Client: Cadent- Gas Network | Role: Product Owner / Test Engineer | Team Size: 7 | Duration: Jan 2021
Jan 2022 | Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: Cadent is a progressive web application designed to manage new and existing gas
connections across European regions, ensuring seamless customer service delivery. The platform allows
users to submit connection, site, contact, and payment details through an intuitive web form. Based on
location and site plans, the system generates detailed quotations and assigns application numbers for
processing through an admin portal. This application streamlines customer requests, optimizes
connection workflows, and enhances service delivery.
Responsibilities
Analysed business needs, created BRDs, FRDs, workflows, and user stories, and defined
acceptance criteria for development.
Collaborated with stakeholders, developers, and QA to ensure requirement clarity, defect
resolution, and smooth releases.
Conducted gap analysis, UAT planning, and data validation to deliver a seamless, cross-platform
customer experience.

targets.text: Sharpflux Technologies Pvt. Ltd (freelancer, Pune)
Product Owner / Test Engineer - (July 2019 – Dec 2020)
Project Name: Chibbs
Client: Chibbs | Role: Software Engineer | Team Size: 12 | Duration: Aug 2019 – Dec 2021 |
Environment: JIRA, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: Chibbs is an online marketplace for homemade food, offering customers a seamless
experience similar to platforms like Zomato and Swiggy. The app provides a wide range of cuisines,
supports multiple payment methods (debit/credit cards, UPI, wallets, COD), and includes dedicated
interfaces for buyers, sellers, and delivery partners. The platform is designed to ensure a simple, user-
friendly ordering and fulfilment process for all stakeholders.
Responsibilities:
Gathered and documented business requirements, workflows, and use cases, translating them
into detailed specifications.
Collaborated with stakeholders, development, and QA teams to align features with business
needs and ensure smooth releases.
Defined user journeys, wireframes, and acceptance criteria to optimize user experience across
buyer, seller, and delivery apps.
Supported UAT planning, defect triage, and process improvements for a stable, customer-
centric platform.
Flextronics Pvt. Ltd., Pune
Software QA Engineer | Jan 2018 – Jun 2019
Worked as a Software QA Engineer with hands-on experience in web application testing, focusing on UI
validation, test execution, and quality assurance across multiple releases.
Key Responsibilities:
Designed and executed detailed test cases based on functional and business requirements.
Performed manual testing across multiple builds and logged, tracked, and managed defects
using Jira.
Collaborated closely with developers to analyze defects, verify fixes, and ensure build stability.
Conducted end-to-end system testing, including basic database validation to ensure data
accuracy.
Developed and maintained automation test scripts to improve test coverage and efficiency.
Software knowledge: -
Testing:
Well acquainted with SDLC and Non-functional testing.
Good knowledge of Functional, Integration, System, Regression, Adhoc and Smoke testing.
SQL:
Good understanding on functions, Sub queries, DDL, DML and TCL commands.
Python:
Good understanding on Operators, methods & functions.
Well acquainted with OOPS & File handling.
Final year Engineering Project: -
Project Title: Design and Development of Automated Egg Shell Cracking and Separating Mechanism.
With the help of PLC programming an automatic system was manufactured.
The project was awarded as the ‘Best Project’ of the year.
As the idea was unique, a patent has been filed as an Intellectual property of India for the
Automatic mechanism.
Patent Docket no: 22917, Application no: 201821019120
Certifications: -
Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO)
Google Cloud Digital Leader
Generative AI Foundation Certificate
Educational Qualification:
Bachelor of Engineering.

sections.label: Skills
sections.text:
Core Competencies:
Product Management & Strategy: Product vision and roadmapping, MVP definition, market and user research, Generative AI Product Ownership, Requirement Gathering, A/B testing, Sprint Planning, and Go-to-market (GTM) execution. Experienced in Epics, Features, User Stories, PRDs, BRDs, and FRDs. • Owned and delivered Agentic AI product capabilities using autonomous AI workflows to automate document analysis, reasoning, and user interactions across enterprise SaaS use cases.
Agile & Delivery: Hands-on experience with Scrum and Kanban, backlog prioritization, sprint ceremonies, cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder management, and end-to-end Agile delivery. • Designed and implemented RAG-based solutions using OpenAI/LLM technologies, integrating enterprise documents and knowledge sources to generate context-aware responses and improve product intelligence.
Led hands-on development and productization of OpenAI-powered GenAI features, working closely with engineering teams on prompt design, retrieval workflows, evaluation, and production deployment.
Product Execution: End-to-end product lifecycle ownership, feature prioritization, Prioritization Frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, Kano), OKRs, Roadmap execution, UAT, release management, and post- launch performance tracking.
Data & Metrics: Definition and tracking of product KPIs, user engagement and retention metrics, funnel analysis, ROI and cost-benefit analysis, and executive reporting.
Technical & Platforms: Working knowledge of API Design and Integrations, Data Modeling, Python, Cloud Platform (AWS, GCP, Azure), Data Analytics (SQL, Tableau, Power BI), Cloud SQL, SaaS architectures, Microservices, CI/CD exposure, Schema Designs and GenAI-enabled product features.
Tools & Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, Pivotal Tracker, Figma, Aha! , Git, Smartsheet, Swagger, Tableau, Miro, Microsoft teams, Google Analytics, MS Excel, Google Sheets and MS Project.
Delivery & Client Engagement: Strong record of on-time delivery, risk/gap analysis, and building long- term client partnerships, positioning organizations as trusted partners over vendors.
Domains: Banking, Healthcare, Telecom, eCommerce, Construction, Travel, Education, and Cloud- based enterprise platforms.

logical_blocks.text:
Product Management & Strategy: Product vision and roadmapping, MVP definition, market and user research, Generative AI Product Ownership, Requirement Gathering, A/B testing, Sprint Planning, and Go-to-market (GTM) execution. Experienced in Epics, Features, User Stories, PRDs, BRDs, and FRDs. • Owned and delivered Agentic AI product capabilities using autonomous AI workflows to automate document analysis, reasoning, and user interactions across enterprise SaaS use cases.
Agile & Delivery: Hands-on experience with Scrum and Kanban, backlog prioritization, sprint ceremonies, cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder management, and end-to-end Agile delivery. • Designed and implemented RAG-based solutions using OpenAI/LLM technologies, integrating enterprise documents and knowledge sources to generate context-aware responses and improve product intelligence.
Led hands-on development and productization of OpenAI-powered GenAI features, working closely with engineering teams on prompt design, retrieval workflows, evaluation, and production deployment.
Product Execution: End-to-end product lifecycle ownership, feature prioritization, Prioritization Frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, Kano), OKRs, Roadmap execution, UAT, release management, and post- launch performance tracking.
Data & Metrics: Definition and tracking of product KPIs, user engagement and retention metrics, funnel analysis, ROI and cost-benefit analysis, and executive reporting.
Technical & Platforms: Working knowledge of API Design and Integrations, Data Modeling, Python, Cloud Platform (AWS, GCP, Azure), Data Analytics (SQL, Tableau, Power BI), Cloud SQL, SaaS architectures, Microservices, CI/CD exposure, Schema Designs and GenAI-enabled product features.
Tools & Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, Pivotal Tracker, Figma, Aha! , Git, Smartsheet, Swagger, Tableau, Miro, Microsoft teams, Google Analytics, MS Excel, Google Sheets and MS Project.
Delivery & Client Engagement: Strong record of on-time delivery, risk/gap analysis, and building long- term client partnerships, positioning organizations as trusted partners over vendors.
Domains: Banking, Healthcare, Telecom, eCommerce, Construction, Travel, Education, and Cloud- based enterprise platforms.

Professional Experience:
Persistent Systems (Bengaluru) Product Manager / Product Owner - (July 2024 - Present)
Project Name: Akordi Client: Laing O’Rourke | Role: Product Manager| Team Size: 30| Duration: July 2024 – Present Environment: JIRA, Confluence, Pivotal Tracker, Python, SQL, APIs, Gitlab.
Description: Akordi is a web-based progressive application developed for engineers in the construction industry to streamline their daily activities. It centralizes data from ongoing Laing O’Rourke projects and assigns user-specific workspaces, enabling engineers to access and contribute project-related information collaboratively within their teams. Designed with a user-focused approach, the platform integrates generative AI to interpret uploaded documents and provide intelligent responses, supporting enhanced productivity and paving the way for future growth through AI-driven innovations.
Responsibilities:
Owned product roadmap and execution for a GenAI-enabled SaaS platform used by engineers.
Drove a 50% improvement in client retention by prioritizing high-impact workflows and AI- assisted document intelligence.
Defined MVP scope, success metrics, and phased roadmap aligned with business outcomes and adoption goals.

Led stakeholder and client requirement analysis to validate problem statements, drive feature prioritization, and ensure alignment with business goals.
Partnered with cross-functional and distributed teams (engineering, design, sales) to deliver bi- weekly releases through Agile ceremonies.
Defined and prioritized the AI product roadmap covering Agentic AI, RAG, LLM and intelligent automation capabilities, translating customer/business requirements into scalable AI features and measurable product outcomes
Created and maintained documentation including FRD, BRD, SRS, epics, and user stories to ensure clear communication across teams.
Established KPI tracking and ROI analysis to guide investment decisions and executive reporting.
Persistent Systems (Bengaluru) Product Owner / Business Analyst - (March 2022 – June 2024)
Client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner / Business Analyst | Team Size: 12 | Duration: March 2022 – June 2024 | Environment: JIRA, Confluence, Pivotal Tracker, Python, SQL, APIs, Gitlab.
Description: Built a web-based surgical video analytics platform used by surgeons to review procedures and enhance training. Led roadmap planning, A/B testing, and cross-functional collaboration. Achieved 60% user retention and reduced onboarding drop-off by 15%.
Responsibilities:
• Responsible for developing a new product strategy for expanding the client portfolio presence in
the marketplace especially focusing on 3rd party life cycle tool integration.

Led the development and launch of a B2B SaaS platform, resulting in a 60% user retention.
Acted as primary decision-maker for backlog prioritization using weighted scoring models tied to retention and revenue impact
Hands-on experience with OpenAI-powered GenAI solutions, leveraging OpenAI LLMs for prompt engineering, RAG-based knowledge retrieval, and development of context-aware enterprise AI capabilities.
Collaborated with engineers, design & sales teams to define product requirements & timelines.
Conducted user interviews and surveys, synthesizing insights to prioritize the features using a weighted scoring model.
Boosted feature adoption by 22% via A/B testing and iterative optimization.
Built product roadmaps and presented updates to C-level stakeholders.
Wrote user stories and managed backlogs in Jira for bi-weekly sprint planning.
Created wireframes & collaborated with UX teams to enhance onboarding, reducing drop-off by 15%.
Assisted in developing KPIs & created dashboards in Tableau for product performance tracking.
Partnered with stakeholders to ensure regulatory compliance across healthcare and telecom domains, reducing operational and reputational risks.
Assisted in preparing budget forecasts and resource utilization plans, optimizing project costs without compromising delivery timelines.
Developed and presented financial and performance reports to senior leadership, providing transparency on product health and profitability.
Client: ConnectSphere, Horizon Networks | Role: Product Manager / Product Owner | Team Size: 20 | Duration: June 2022 – March 2023| Environment: JIRA, Confluence, Figma, APIs, Swagger, SQL
Description: OmniLink is a next-gen telecom order management and service provisioning platform built for major telecom providers, ConnectSphere and Horizon Networks. It streamlined customer onboarding across broadband, mobile, and VoIP services by unifying service journeys and automating backend provisioning. The platform integrated with legacy OSS/BSS systems, enabling real-time tracking, reducing manual interventions, and significantly improving service activation timelines and customer experience.
Responsibilities:
Managed the design and delivery of a cloud-based order management platform, reducing provisioning time by 75%.
Defined the product roadmap and MVP in alignment with business goals and customer pain points.
Defined end-to-end service journeys across broadband, mobile, and VoIP, improving order success rate by 35%
Partnered with UI/UX teams to improve user journeys, enhancing order success and customer satisfaction.
Oversaw seamless integration with OSS/BSS systems to enable automation and accurate data flow.
Created and maintained user stories, epics, and documentation in JIRA and Confluence.

Led UAT efforts, coordinated release plans, and supported internal training and change management.
Developed and presented financial and performance reports to senior leadership, providing transparency on product health and profitability.
Assisted in preparing budget forecasts and resource utilization plans, optimizing project costs without compromising delivery timelines.
Tracked KPIs post-launch, achieving a 35% increase in successful order completions and reduced inquiries.
Mediaagility Pvt. Ltd (Acquired by Persistent Systems) Product Owner - (Jan 2021 – March 2022)
Client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner | Team Size: 8 | Duration: Apr 2021 – Feb 2022 | Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: SP Portal is a progressive web application developed for Whirlpool's internal operations, supporting multiple user roles including District Managers, Service Providers, and Administrators who oversee overall application management. Its primary purpose is to streamline the claims process by enabling users to filter and manage claims based on status, time, and other criteria. The application features a dedicated section for viewing individual claim details & another for consolidating multiple claims using claim numbers. It facilitates smooth claim processing by allowing District Managers to initiate actions which are then carried forward by Service Providers, ensuring efficient and organized workflow.
Responsibilities
Gathered and analyzed business requirements, system specifications, and translated them into BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Defined project scope, timelines, and strategies; facilitated stakeholder meetings and workshops for requirement clarification.
Acted as a liaison between business, QA, and development teams, ensuring defect resolution, quality delivery, and smooth release cycles.
Planned and executed UAT, analyzed gaps, and recommended process improvements for better business outcomes.
Utilized tools like JIRA, Confluence, and Katalon Studio for documentation, traceability, and process optimization.
Client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner / Test Engineer | Team Size: 6 | Duration: Oct 2021 – Apr 2022 | Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git
Description: Whirlpool Sales Strategy and Operations is a progressive web application developed for internal use within Whirlpool. It supports three distinct user roles—Admin, Editor, and General User— each with role-specific access and permissions. The application serves as a centralized platform to display ongoing organizational projects, offering complete project details, trending updates, quick links, and progress reports. It also includes features such as user location tracking to enhance visibility. Designed to be user-friendly, the application ensures a seamless experience across mobile, desktop, and tablet devices, with the goal of improving accessibility and engagement for all users.
Responsibilities
Analysed system specifications and translated requirements into detailed documentation, scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
Coordinated with developers, QA, and clients to track defects, ensure quality, and deliver seamless product releases.

Led multi-device, cross-platform verification, UAT planning, and execution to validate business needs.
Supported automation initiatives and database validations, recommending improvements for better system performance.
Client: Cadent- Gas Network | Role: Product Owner / Test Engineer | Team Size: 7 | Duration: Jan 2021 – Jan 2022 | Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: Cadent is a progressive web application designed to manage new and existing gas connections across European regions, ensuring seamless customer service delivery. The platform allows users to submit connection, site, contact, and payment details through an intuitive web form. Based on location and site plans, the system generates detailed quotations and assigns application numbers for processing through an admin portal. This application streamlines customer requests, optimizes connection workflows, and enhances service delivery.
Responsibilities
Analysed business needs, created BRDs, FRDs, workflows, and user stories, and defined acceptance criteria for development.
Collaborated with stakeholders, developers, and QA to ensure requirement clarity, defect resolution, and smooth releases.
Conducted gap analysis, UAT planning, and data validation to deliver a seamless, cross-platform customer experience.
Sharpflux Technologies Pvt. Ltd (freelancer, Pune) Product Owner / Test Engineer - (July 2019 – Dec 2020)
Project Name: Chibbs Client: Chibbs | Role: Software Engineer | Team Size: 12 | Duration: Aug 2019 – Dec 2021 | Environment: JIRA, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: Chibbs is an online marketplace for homemade food, offering customers a seamless experience similar to platforms like Zomato and Swiggy. The app provides a wide range of cuisines, supports multiple payment methods (debit/credit cards, UPI, wallets, COD), and includes dedicated interfaces for buyers, sellers, and delivery partners. The platform is designed to ensure a simple, user- friendly ordering and fulfilment process for all stakeholders.
Responsibilities:
Gathered and documented business requirements, workflows, and use cases, translating them
into detailed specifications.
Collaborated with stakeholders, development, and QA teams to align features with business
needs and ensure smooth releases.
Defined user journeys, wireframes, and acceptance criteria to optimize user experience across
buyer, seller, and delivery apps.
Supported UAT planning, defect triage, and process improvements for a stable, customer-
centric platform.
Flextronics Pvt. Ltd., Pune Software QA Engineer | Jan 2018 – Jun 2019
Worked as a Software QA Engineer with hands-on experience in web application testing, focusing on UI validation, test execution, and quality assurance across multiple releases.
Key Responsibilities:
Designed and executed detailed test cases based on functional and business requirements. • Performed manual testing across multiple builds and logged, tracked, and managed defects using Jira.
Collaborated closely with developers to analyze defects, verify fixes, and ensure build stability. • Conducted end-to-end system testing, including basic database validation to ensure data accuracy.
Developed and maintained automation test scripts to improve test coverage and efficiency.
Software knowledge: - Testing:
Well acquainted with SDLC and Non-functional testing. • Good knowledge of Functional, Integration, System, Regression, Adhoc and Smoke testing.
SQL:
Good understanding on functions, Sub queries, DDL, DML and TCL commands.
Python:
Good understanding on Operators, methods & functions. • Well acquainted with OOPS & File handling.
Final year Engineering Project: - Project Title: Design and Development of Automated Egg Shell Cracking and Separating Mechanism.
With the help of PLC programming an automatic system was manufactured. • The project was awarded as the ‘Best Project’ of the year. • As the idea was unique, a patent has been filed as an Intellectual property of India for the Automatic mechanism.

Project Name: Akordi Client: Laing O’Rourke | Role: Product Manager| Team Size: 30| Duration: July 2024 – Present Environment: JIRA, Confluence, Pivotal Tracker, Python, SQL, APIs, Gitlab.
Description: Akordi is a web-based progressive application developed for engineers in the construction industry to streamline their daily activities. It centralizes data from ongoing Laing O’Rourke projects and assigns user-specific workspaces, enabling engineers to access and contribute project-related information collaboratively within their teams. Designed with a user-focused approach, the platform integrates generative AI to interpret uploaded documents and provide intelligent responses, supporting enhanced productivity and paving the way for future growth through AI-driven innovations.
Responsibilities:
Owned product roadmap and execution for a GenAI-enabled SaaS platform used by engineers.
Drove a 50% improvement in client retention by prioritizing high-impact workflows and AI- assisted document intelligence.
Defined MVP scope, success metrics, and phased roadmap aligned with business outcomes and adoption goals.
Led stakeholder and client requirement analysis to validate problem statements, drive feature prioritization, and ensure alignment with business goals.
Partnered with cross-functional and distributed teams (engineering, design, sales) to deliver bi- weekly releases through Agile ceremonies.
Defined and prioritized the AI product roadmap covering Agentic AI, RAG, LLM and intelligent automation capabilities, translating customer/business requirements into scalable AI features and measurable product outcomes
Created and maintained documentation including FRD, BRD, SRS, epics, and user stories to ensure clear communication across teams.
Established KPI tracking and ROI analysis to guide investment decisions and executive reporting.

Client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner / Test Engineer | Team Size: 6 | Duration: Oct 2021 – Apr 2022 | Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git

targets.text: Persistent Systems (Bengaluru)
Product Owner / Business Analyst - (March 2022 – June 2024)
Project Name: Caresyntax
Client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner / Business Analyst | Team Size: 12 | Duration: March 2022 –
June 2024 | Environment: JIRA, Confluence, Pivotal Tracker, Python, SQL, APIs, Gitlab.
Description: Built a web-based surgical video analytics platform used by surgeons to review procedures
and enhance training. Led roadmap planning, A/B testing, and cross-functional collaboration. Achieved
60% user retention and reduced onboarding drop-off by 15%.
Responsibilities:
Responsible for developing a new product strategy for expanding the client portfolio presence in
the marketplace especially focusing on 3rd party life cycle tool integration.
Led the development and launch of a B2B SaaS platform, resulting in a 60% user retention.
Acted as primary decision-maker for backlog prioritization using weighted scoring models tied to
retention and revenue impact
Hands-on experience with OpenAI-powered GenAI solutions, leveraging OpenAI LLMs for
prompt engineering, RAG-based knowledge retrieval, and development of context-aware
enterprise AI capabilities.
Collaborated with engineers, design & sales teams to define product requirements & timelines.
Conducted user interviews and surveys, synthesizing insights to prioritize the features using a
weighted scoring model.
Boosted feature adoption by 22% via A/B testing and iterative optimization.
Built product roadmaps and presented updates to C-level stakeholders.
Wrote user stories and managed backlogs in Jira for bi-weekly sprint planning.
Created wireframes & collaborated with UX teams to enhance onboarding, reducing drop-off by
Assisted in developing KPIs & created dashboards in Tableau for product performance tracking.
Partnered with stakeholders to ensure regulatory compliance across healthcare and telecom
domains, reducing operational and reputational risks.
Assisted in preparing budget forecasts and resource utilization plans, optimizing project costs
without compromising delivery timelines.
Developed and presented financial and performance reports to senior leadership, providing
transparency on product health and profitability.
Project Name: OmniLink
Client: ConnectSphere, Horizon Networks | Role: Product Manager / Product Owner | Team Size: 20 |
Duration: June 2022 – March 2023| Environment: JIRA, Confluence, Figma, APIs, Swagger, SQL
Description: OmniLink is a next-gen telecom order management and service provisioning platform built
for major telecom providers, ConnectSphere and Horizon Networks. It streamlined customer onboarding
across broadband, mobile, and VoIP services by unifying service journeys and automating backend
provisioning. The platform integrated with legacy OSS/BSS systems, enabling real-time tracking,
reducing manual interventions, and significantly improving service activation timelines and customer
Responsibilities:
Managed the design and delivery of a cloud-based order management platform, reducing
provisioning time by 75%.
Defined the product roadmap and MVP in alignment with business goals and customer pain
points.
Defined end-to-end service journeys across broadband, mobile, and VoIP, improving order
success rate by 35%
Partnered with UI/UX teams to improve user journeys, enhancing order success and customer
satisfaction.
Oversaw seamless integration with OSS/BSS systems to enable automation and accurate data
flow.
Created and maintained user stories, epics, and documentation in JIRA and Confluence.
Led UAT efforts, coordinated release plans, and supported internal training and change
management.
Developed and presented financial and performance reports to senior leadership, providing
transparency on product health and profitability.
Assisted in preparing budget forecasts and resource utilization plans, optimizing project costs
without compromising delivery timelines.
Tracked KPIs post-launch, achieving a 35% increase in successful order completions and reduced
inquiries.
Mediaagility Pvt. Ltd (Acquired by Persistent Systems)
Product Owner - (Jan 2021 – March 2022)
Project Name: SP Portal
Client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner | Team Size: 8 | Duration: Apr 2021 – Feb 2022 |
Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: SP Portal is a progressive web application developed for Whirlpool's internal operations,
supporting multiple user roles including District Managers, Service Providers, and Administrators who
oversee overall application management. Its primary purpose is to streamline the claims process by
enabling users to filter and manage claims based on status, time, and other criteria. The application
features a dedicated section for viewing individual claim details & another for consolidating multiple
claims using claim numbers. It facilitates smooth claim processing by allowing District Managers to initiate
actions which are then carried forward by Service Providers, ensuring efficient and organized workflow.
Responsibilities
Gathered and analyzed business requirements, system specifications, and translated them into
BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Defined project scope, timelines, and strategies; facilitated stakeholder meetings and
workshops for requirement clarification.
Acted as a liaison between business, QA, and development teams, ensuring defect resolution,
quality delivery, and smooth release cycles.
Planned and executed UAT, analyzed gaps, and recommended process improvements for better
business outcomes.
Utilized tools like JIRA, Confluence, and Katalon Studio for documentation, traceability, and
process optimization.
Project Name: Whirlpool Sales Strategy and Operations
Client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner / Test Engineer | Team Size: 6 | Duration: Oct 2021 – Apr 2022
| Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git
Description: Whirlpool Sales Strategy and Operations is a progressive web application developed for
internal use within Whirlpool. It supports three distinct user roles—Admin, Editor, and General User—
each with role-specific access and permissions. The application serves as a centralized platform to display
ongoing organizational projects, offering complete project details, trending updates, quick links, and
progress reports. It also includes features such as user location tracking to enhance visibility. Designed to
be user-friendly, the application ensures a seamless experience across mobile, desktop, and tablet
devices, with the goal of improving accessibility and engagement for all users.
Responsibilities
Analysed system specifications and translated requirements into detailed documentation,
scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
Coordinated with developers, QA, and clients to track defects, ensure quality, and deliver
seamless product releases.
Led multi-device, cross-platform verification, UAT planning, and execution to validate business
needs.
Supported automation initiatives and database validations, recommending improvements for
better system performance.
Project Name: Cadent
Client: Cadent- Gas Network | Role: Product Owner / Test Engineer | Team Size: 7 | Duration: Jan 2021
Jan 2022 | Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: Cadent is a progressive web application designed to manage new and existing gas
connections across European regions, ensuring seamless customer service delivery. The platform allows
users to submit connection, site, contact, and payment details through an intuitive web form. Based on
location and site plans, the system generates detailed quotations and assigns application numbers for
processing through an admin portal. This application streamlines customer requests, optimizes
connection workflows, and enhances service delivery.
Responsibilities
Analysed business needs, created BRDs, FRDs, workflows, and user stories, and defined
acceptance criteria for development.
Collaborated with stakeholders, developers, and QA to ensure requirement clarity, defect
resolution, and smooth releases.
Conducted gap analysis, UAT planning, and data validation to deliver a seamless, cross-platform
customer experience.

targets.text: Sharpflux Technologies Pvt. Ltd (freelancer, Pune)
Product Owner / Test Engineer - (July 2019 – Dec 2020)
Project Name: Chibbs
Client: Chibbs | Role: Software Engineer | Team Size: 12 | Duration: Aug 2019 – Dec 2021 |
Environment: JIRA, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: Chibbs is an online marketplace for homemade food, offering customers a seamless
experience similar to platforms like Zomato and Swiggy. The app provides a wide range of cuisines,
supports multiple payment methods (debit/credit cards, UPI, wallets, COD), and includes dedicated
interfaces for buyers, sellers, and delivery partners. The platform is designed to ensure a simple, user-
friendly ordering and fulfilment process for all stakeholders.
Responsibilities:
Gathered and documented business requirements, workflows, and use cases, translating them
into detailed specifications.
Collaborated with stakeholders, development, and QA teams to align features with business
needs and ensure smooth releases.
Defined user journeys, wireframes, and acceptance criteria to optimize user experience across
buyer, seller, and delivery apps.
Supported UAT planning, defect triage, and process improvements for a stable, customer-
centric platform.
Flextronics Pvt. Ltd., Pune
Software QA Engineer | Jan 2018 – Jun 2019
Worked as a Software QA Engineer with hands-on experience in web application testing, focusing on UI
validation, test execution, and quality assurance across multiple releases.
Key Responsibilities:
Designed and executed detailed test cases based on functional and business requirements.
Performed manual testing across multiple builds and logged, tracked, and managed defects
using Jira.
Collaborated closely with developers to analyze defects, verify fixes, and ensure build stability.
Conducted end-to-end system testing, including basic database validation to ensure data
accuracy.
Developed and maintained automation test scripts to improve test coverage and efficiency.
Software knowledge: -
Testing:
Well acquainted with SDLC and Non-functional testing.
Good knowledge of Functional, Integration, System, Regression, Adhoc and Smoke testing.
SQL:
Good understanding on functions, Sub queries, DDL, DML and TCL commands.
Python:
Good understanding on Operators, methods & functions.
Well acquainted with OOPS & File handling.
Final year Engineering Project: -
Project Title: Design and Development of Automated Egg Shell Cracking and Separating Mechanism.
With the help of PLC programming an automatic system was manufactured.
The project was awarded as the ‘Best Project’ of the year.
As the idea was unique, a patent has been filed as an Intellectual property of India for the
Automatic mechanism.
Patent Docket no: 22917, Application no: 201821019120
Certifications: -
Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO)
Google Cloud Digital Leader
Generative AI Foundation Certificate
Educational Qualification:
Bachelor of Engineering.

raw_sections.summary:
Profile Summary
Product Manager with 8.5+ years of experience building and scaling B2B and B2C SaaS products across construction, healthcare, telecom, banking, and eCommerce. Proven in defining product vision, executing roadmaps, and delivering measurable outcomes such as 50–75% efficiency gains, 60%+ user retention, and double-digit adoption growth. Strong in customer discovery, stakeholder alignment, and Agile delivery, with experience driving cloud-based product evolution and leveraging Generative AI to improve productivity and business impact.
raw_sections.skills:
Core Competencies:
Product Management & Strategy: Product vision and roadmapping, MVP definition, market and user research, Generative AI Product Ownership, Requirement Gathering, A/B testing, Sprint Planning, and Go-to-market (GTM) execution. Experienced in Epics, Features, User Stories, PRDs, BRDs, and FRDs. • Owned and delivered Agentic AI product capabilities using autonomous AI workflows to automate document analysis, reasoning, and user interactions across enterprise SaaS use cases.
Agile & Delivery: Hands-on experience with Scrum and Kanban, backlog prioritization, sprint ceremonies, cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder management, and end-to-end Agile delivery. • Designed and implemented RAG-based solutions using OpenAI/LLM technologies, integrating enterprise documents and knowledge sources to generate context-aware responses and improve product intelligence.
Led hands-on development and productization of OpenAI-powered GenAI features, working closely with engineering teams on prompt design, retrieval workflows, evaluation, and production deployment.
Product Execution: End-to-end product lifecycle ownership, feature prioritization, Prioritization Frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, Kano), OKRs, Roadmap execution, UAT, release management, and post- launch performance tracking.
Data & Metrics: Definition and tracking of product KPIs, user engagement and retention metrics, funnel analysis, ROI and cost-benefit analysis, and executive reporting.
Technical & Platforms: Working knowledge of API Design and Integrations, Data Modeling, Python, Cloud Platform (AWS, GCP, Azure), Data Analytics (SQL, Tableau, Power BI), Cloud SQL, SaaS architectures, Microservices, CI/CD exposure, Schema Designs and GenAI-enabled product features.
Tools & Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, Pivotal Tracker, Figma, Aha! , Git, Smartsheet, Swagger, Tableau, Miro, Microsoft teams, Google Analytics, MS Excel, Google Sheets and MS Project.
Delivery & Client Engagement: Strong record of on-time delivery, risk/gap analysis, and building long- term client partnerships, positioning organizations as trusted partners over vendors.
Domains: Banking, Healthcare, Telecom, eCommerce, Construction, Travel, Education, and Cloud- based enterprise platforms.
